-- Big number helpers using arrays of digits in a given base
local function norm(a) local n=#a; while n>1 and a[n]==0 do n=n-1 end; a[n+1]=nil; if #a==0 then a[1]=0 end end

local function mul_small(a, m)
  local carry=0
  for i=1,#a do
    local v=a[i]*m+carry
    a[i]=v % BASE
    carry=math.floor(v/BASE)
  end
  while carry>0 do a[#a+1]=carry % BASE; carry=math.floor(carry/BASE) end
  norm(a)
end

local function add_small(a, m)
  local carry=m
  local i=1
  while carry>0 do
    if i>#a then a[i]=0 end
    local v=a[i]+carry
    a[i]=v % BASE
    carry=math.floor(v/BASE)
    i=i+1
  end
  norm(a)
end

BASE = 1000000000000000  -- 1e15

local function to_dec_str(a)
  local parts={}
  for i=#a,1,-1 do
    if i==#a then parts[#parts+1]=tostring(a[i])
    else parts[#parts+1]=string.rep("0",15-tostring(a[i]):len())..tostring(a[i]) end
  end
  return table.concat(parts)
end

-- from string in base b (b <= 16), digits given as string
local function from_base(s, b)
  local a={0}
  for i=1,s:len() do
    local c=s:sub(i,i)
    local d=tonumber(c,16)
    mul_small(a,b)
    add_small(a,d)
  end
  return a
end

local function to_base_str(a, b)
  -- repeated divmod by b using schoolbook division
  local digits={}
  local tmp={} for i=1,#a do tmp[i]=a[i] end
  while true do
    norm(tmp)
    if #tmp==1 and tmp[1]==0 then break end
    local rem=0
    for i=#tmp,1,-1 do
      local v=rem*BASE+tmp[i]
      tmp[i]=math.floor(v/b)
      rem=v % b
    end
    norm(tmp)
    digits[#digits+1]=rem
  end
  if #digits==0 then digits[1]=0 end
  local out={}
  for i=#digits,1,-1 do out[#out+1]=string.upper(string.format("%x",digits[i])) end
  return table.concat(out)
end

local hex1 = to_base_str(a1, 16)
